sourceText.he: מַעֲשֵׂר שֵׁנִי וְהֶקְדֵּשׁ שֶׁנִּפְדּוּ: פְּשִׁיטָא! הָכָא בְּמַאי עָסְקִינַן — כְּגוֹן שֶׁנָּתַן אֶת הַקֶּרֶן, וְלֹא נָתַן אֶת הַחוֹמֶשׁ. וְהָא קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן דְּאֵין חוֹמֶשׁ מְעַכֵּב.

positions.claim: one who ate redeemed second tithe or redeemed consecrated food is included in a zimmun
the mishna speaks of a redemption where the principal was paid but not the fifth, and teaches that the fifth is not indispensable
